problem:
Let $E=[\begin{aligned}\frac{2}{3} \\ -\sqrt{3} \\ 5 \\ 0 \\ -4\end{aligned}].$ 
The dimensions of the matrix $E$ are{{field-1}}
$\times $
{{field-2}}.
worked_solution: The matrix $E$ has $5$ rows and $1$ columns. Therefore, its dimensions are $5\times 1.$
